prerequisites: Binds port 3100; playwright.config.ts starts `next dev` on the fixture adapter itself, no token or network needed.
Must run with the Claude Code Bash sandbox disabled: the dev server and Turbopack bind local ports.

notes: `npm test` (vitest, jsdom) and `npm run typecheck` run fine inside the Bash sandbox; `npm run build` and `npm run test:e2e` do not (port binding), see .claude/memory/failure-modes/.
A failed sandboxed `next build` poisons `.next`; run `rm -rf .next && npm run build` unsandboxed.
Baseline 2026-09-05: 22 files, 204 unit tests green; 1 e2e green; lint and typecheck clean.
